title: plagiospermum uniflorum
intro: Plagiospermum uniflorum, commonly known as the "Indian Spurge", is a plant species native to India, known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Plagiospermum uniflorum include its use in treating fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate cough, and soothe respiratory tract infections. The bioactive constituents of Plagiospermum uniflorum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
